action.action-desc: Mr. Crank introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Financial Services

form.official-title: To require that certain payments to Federal student loans to the buyer of a home be classified as a financial concession by the Federal National Mortgage Association and the Federal Home Loan Mortgage Association.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the First Time Homebuyer Debt Reduction Act.

section.header: Classification of student loan payment as a financial concession

subsection.text: Not later than 30 days after the enactment of this Act, the Director of the Federal Housing Finance Agency shall require the enterprises to classify a covered payment as a financial concession with respect to an interested party contribution in the sale of a home, subject to the limitation described in subsection (b).
A portion of a covered payment that is in excess of $25,000 shall be classified as a sales concession.

subparagraph.text: the Federal National Mortgage Association; and
the Federal Home Loan Mortgage Association.

paragraph.text: The term covered payment means a payment towards a student loan, as defined in Title IV of the Higher Education Act, by an interested party to the buyer of a home.
Newly constructed principal residence of the buyer of a home.
